entities.name: Blackblade
entities.description: A mystical soul-drinking weapon forged by Dakkon with the lives of many victims, later wielded by Gideon Jura against Belzenlok, Rhonas and Nicol Bolas before shattering.

entities.name: Dakkon
entities.description: A blacksmith promised the power of a god by Geyadrone Dihada, who forged the Blackblade by sacrificing his son and countless slaves, and whose soul Dihada stole.

entities.name: Geyadrone Dihada
entities.description: A planeswalker who commissioned the Blackblade and betrayed Dakkon to create the ultimate warrior.

entities.name: Daron
entities.description: Dakkon's young son, killed by his father to feed the sword.

entities.name: Sol'Kanar the Swamp King
entities.description: Geyadrone's servant who used the Blackblade until Dakkon took it back.

entities.name: Piru
entities.description: An Elder Dragon summoned by Dihada against Dakkon and killed by the Blackblade.

entities.name: Chromium Rhuell
entities.description: An Elder Dragon summoned by Dihada to attack Dakkon alongside Piru.

entities.name: Dueling Chasm of Golthonor
entities.description: A chasm created by the energy blast released when Piru was killed.

entities.name: Corondor
entities.description: Region where Dakkon bought slaves from among the worst villains.

entities.name: Terisiare
entities.description: Continent to which Dakkon and the Blackblade traveled.

entities.name: Korlash
entities.description: Possible descendant of Dakkon who came to possess the reforged sword.

entities.name: Needle
entities.description: A Cabal minion into whose possession the Blackblade came around 4560 AR.

entities.name: Belzenlok
entities.description: The Cabal's leader, an Elder Demon, whose soul was drained by the Blackblade.

entities.name: Cabal
entities.description: The demonic cult that held the Blackblade and rewrote its origins.

entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: A planeswalker who stole the Blackblade and used it against Belzenlok and in the War of the Spark.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A planeswalker who taunted Belzenlok and activated the Blackblade's curse on him.

entities.name: Rhonas
entities.description: A God-Eternal drained by the Blackblade into a husk during the War of the Spark.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: An Elder Dragon who enchanted the Blackblade so it could never hurt another elder dragon.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The plane where the War of the Spark's final confrontation took place.

entities.name: War of the Spark
entities.description: The final confrontation with Nicol Bolas on Ravnica.

entities.name: Immortal Sun
entities.description: Artifact that trapped planeswalkers on Ravnica.

entities.name: Jhoira
entities.description: A corsair who in the Echoverse stole the Blackblade from the Cabal.

entities.name: New Argive
entities.description: Terisiaran island where the Blackblade apparently remained.

events.summary: Dakkon forges the Blackblade, sacrificing his own blood, then his son Daron, then countless slaves over the following years.
events.quote: Dakkon plunged the white-hot metal into his own son's chest.

events.summary: Geyadrone receives the Blackblade and steals Dakkon's soul by stabbing his shadow with the sword.
events.quote: she stabbed Dakkon's shadow on the ground, treacherously stealing his soul with the sword

events.summary: Dakkon stabs Piru with the Blackblade, killing her; the blast creates the Dueling Chasm of Golthonor and Dihada absorbs Piru's soul power.
events.quote: he stabbed Piru with the Blackblade, killing her.

events.summary: Dihada binds Dakkon to her will and he travels to Terisiare with the Blackblade.
events.quote: Dihada managed to "tag" Dakkon, binding him to her will.

events.summary: Around 4560 AR the Blackblade comes into the possession of the Cabal minion Needle, and the Cabal rewrites its origins.
events.quote: would come into the possession of the Cabal minion Needle

events.summary: Gideon steals the Blackblade from the Cabal vaults and confronts Belzenlok; Liliana's taunting lets Gideon lodge it in the demon's leg and Liliana activates its curse, draining Belzenlok's soul.
events.quote: Liliana grasped its hilt and activated its curse, draining Belzenlok's soul

events.summary: Gideon stabs Rhonas in the eye with the Blackblade, draining the God-Eternal to dust.
events.quote: Gideon stabbed him in the eye with the Blackblade

events.summary: Gideon strikes Bolas's head with the Blackblade but it breaks; Bolas reveals he had enchanted it to never hurt another elder dragon.
events.quote: the sword broke against its flesh

relations.note: Forged it after Dihada promised him godlike power.

relations.quote: He called to his side his young son, Daron
he stabbed Piru with the Blackblade, killing her.
Geyadrone's servant, Sol'Kanar the Swamp King

relations.note: Drained his soul with the Blackblade's curse.

relations.quote: draining the God-Eternal into a husk that quickly crumbled into dust
